note: Parking and hazard spots read off the Pelham Border Riders' 2022 town trail map picture, plus two locations the club links to directly. Positions from the picture are good to roughly 100 ft. Confirm before trailering.

pois.detail: 11 Mammoth Rd, Pelham. Listed by the club as the trailer drop.
